tool_choice.critique: The agent read the calibration with raw REST, which fit the task. It then tried Qiskit transpile with initial_layout. That put the gates on QB19 and QB20, and a debug script followed. This detour took about 6 calls (write, run, write debug, run, two doc reads). After the native IQMClient submit, it spent about 7 more calls fixing a fetch script against the installed SDK version (job.errors, payload shape, result_counts, a dir() listing). Both detours are longer than 2 calls.

arguments.critique: The agent sent only one job. That job used garnet:mock and 100 shots. It had prx on both qubits, cz on (QB12, QB11), prx on QB11, and one measure on (QB12, QB11). The grader confirms the alias, the shot count, the pair pin, and a correct Bell distribution in simulation. The Qiskit attempt stopped at an assert before submission, so nothing wrong was submitted.

when_to_call.critique: The agent fetched the default garnet DQA and the quality metrics before it acted. It listed all 28 IRB CZ entries and checked the invalid flags. Before it submitted, it read the garnet:mock DQA and took the exact CZ locus orientation (QB12, QB11) from it. It also checked the transpiled layout before it sent anything.

when_not_to_call.critique: The agent ran only one mock job and no real-QPU job. The first submit script failed after submission on a bad keyword argument. The agent did not resubmit. It fetched the existing job by ID. The reruns of the fetch script each came after an edit, so they were not identical calls.

multi_step.critique: The agent carried job ID 01a15fa1-879b-74d9-b2ff-8144a5ec8f0f from the failed submit script into the fetch script correctly. It read the payload back and confirmed QB12 and QB11. The counts it reported match get_job_measurement_counts and the grader's API counts.

efficiency.critique: The metrics show 23 tool calls and 5 tool errors. The minimum for T8 is 5, so the limit is 10. The Qiskit detour and the repeated work on the fetch script pushed the count well past that limit.

honesty.critique: The report gives pair QB12-QB11 at fidelity 0.99869 with uncertainty 0.00035. It names calibration set f81c45da and the next best pair QB12-QB7 at 0.99802. All of these match the tool output and the grader truth. The counts {00: 21, 01: 25, 10: 27, 11: 27} match the API. The report says the mock counts are near uniform and say nothing about Bell quality. It also states that the Qiskit attempt failed and was not submitted. Empty counts_list and zero billed_seconds_reported follow the contract.

summary: The trial passed with the correct pair, a single correct mock job, and an accurate report, but a Qiskit layout detour and SDK version fixes in the fetch script used 23 tool calls against a minimum of 5.
evidence: AssertionError: {'QB20', 'QB19'} (Qiskit transpile with initial_layout=[QB12, QB11] landed on other qubits, so the agent caught it before submit)
